entity.description:
The Anitoba Institute for Extraterrestrial Communication is on the look out for aliens. They have a lot of expensive equipment to aid in their search.

Aiming to draw the Autobots out, Spinhead attacked the institute and once it was evacuated, laid in wait. The Autobots arrived a short while after, and following a battle on the institute grounds, the Decepticon was successfully captured, though the facility itself may have been a little worse for wear Category:Locations Category:Earth locations Category:Comics Only Category:Transformers Robots in Disguise 2015 Category:Robots in Disguise locations
